# `from_csv`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns a struct value with the given `csvStr` and `schema`.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
from_csv(csvStr, schema[, options])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `csv_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- from_csv, example 1
> SELECT from_csv('1, 0.8', 'a INT, b DOUBLE');
{"a":1,"b":0.8}
```

```sql
-- from_csv, example 2
> SELECT from_csv('26/08/2015', 'time Timestamp', map('timestampFormat', 'dd/MM/yyyy'));
{"time":2015-08-26 00:00:00}
```
